dimensions.detail: no identifier-like text columns among features

quality.note: Scores describe the data as published. Nothing here is repaired at the ingestion layer; remediation happens inside the modelling pipeline where it can be fitted per-fold.

class_balance.note: A detector that flags nothing scores 96.6% accuracy. That is why accuracy appears nowhere in this project's headline.

label_policy: Detectors are fitted on X alone. The label is used only to score the resulting rankings. Contamination is set from a stated operational assumption (2%), not from the observed rate (3.37%) -- in deployment that rate is unknown, and supplying it would be leaking the answer through a hyperparameter.
